items.author: tensquaresoftware
items.body:
## Problem

When a BMad agent reaches a decision point — for example during `/bmad-code-review` — it often presents the user with a question or a set of options, but without stating which option it would itself recommend. The user is left to weigh the trade-offs alone, even in cases where the agent clearly has enough context to have an opinion. The user can ask for a recommendation explicitly, but only by requesting it manually each time a question or decision comes up — there's no way to make this the default behavior.

This is especially costly during interactive workflows where multiple sma
items.title: [Enhancement] Add option to always surface the BMad agent's recommendation when a question or decision point is raised
